```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

breeding_sites<- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")

gt(breeding_sites)

colnames(breeding_sites)
glimpse(breeding_sites)
print (nrow(breeding_sites))
print(ncol(breeding_sites))
print(dim(breeding_sites))
```
```{r}
migration_connectivity <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(migration_connectivity))

glimpse(dim(migration_connectivity))
glimpse(migration_connectivity$Tag)

```
```{r}
breeding_sites_selected <-breeding_sites|> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(breeding_sites_selected)


```

```{r}

bird_migration <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")

gt(bird_migration)

bird_migration_selected<-bird_migration |> 
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude,pslon,pslat,iblat,awestlon,awestlat) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, 
         Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
         Stopover_longitude = pslon,
         Stopover_latitude = pslat,
         Iberian_longitude = iblon,
         Iberian_latitude = iblat,
         Westmost_longitude = awestlon,
         Westmost_latitude = awestlat)

get(birdmigration_selected)

```
